text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>... Truly impressive skill. I am 
deeply in your debt.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...You're right, Meek. It is frustrating, 
very much so.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
However... Trainer <username>, the run from you and 
your Umamusume truly inspired us!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...I will shine. ...I will, no matter 
what.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
There was so much to learn, wasn't there, 
Bitter Glasse? As expected, <username>-san is a 
wonderful Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...And an Umamusume who can live up to it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But you were magnificent as well. 
Watching your growth makes me realize that 
limits don't exist. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
What happened gave me an idea for a new 
tactic. I'll share it with Trainer <username> later 
and polish it even further.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, thank you. ...Mm, I'll try 
even harder. ...I can do this. Mun!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
No, thank *you*... Little Cocon. Let's 
keep putting in the effort together from 
here on out!
